purpose: HSPICE .acphasenoise reads the .noise output of a phase-domain circuit as phase noise in dBc/Hz.

oracle.derivation: Phase-domain RC: the output phase PSD is S(f) = 4kTR/(1+(f/fc)^2) rad^2/Hz at 25 degC (k = 1.38064852e-23 J/K, CODATA 2014), fc = 1/(2 pi R C); PHNOISE is the single-sideband phase noise L(f) = S(f)/2 in dBc/Hz, the definition of IEEE Std 1139.
oracle.confirmed_reason: IEEE 1139 defines L(f) = S_phi(f)/2; that HSPICE's PHNOISE column is this L(f) is not in the HSPICE manuals available here, and no second simulator runs .acphasenoise.
